reference.h_interpretation: inverse-law limit h -> 0+, not an admissible theorem instance
reference.calibration_status: illustrative SI reference pair; profile and viscosity compatibility not established

air.locator: Equation (11) and Table 3, printed p. 35 / PDF p. 5
air.notes: Dry-air reference. Mean free path uses the NIST paper's convention. Density and sound speed are ideal-gas estimates using rounded R and gamma assumptions, not additional measured NIST values. Properties are frozen for screening, not evolved along collapse.

water.notes: Liquid-water reference at 25 C and 0.1 MPa. n^(-1/3) is a mean-spacing estimate. Viscosity and sound speed are frozen reference values, not a high-speed equation of state.

constants.edition: CODATA 2022; c, N_A and k_B are exact SI constants; a0 rounded from CODATA

screens.interpretation: screens and illustrative rate marker; no universal failure criterion

gradient_interpretation: L=beta*a is assumed; no evaluated field gradient or phase wavelength

pulse.interpretation: anchored bare power laws; h=0 is a limit, ceiling excluded, finite h not proof-certified; no phase/envelope factors or wavelength calibration

time_interpretation: crossing times only; no dimensional time to the proposed singularity
